name: XLA_AE_SEGMENT_VALUES
description: This table contains information about the balancing or management segment values associated with the journal entry.

columns.name: SEGMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the segment type. The segment type can have  values B or M. B indicates Balancing   Segment, M indicates Management Segment.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the value of the balancing or the management  segment.

columns.name: AE_LINES_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates the number of journal lines associated with the segment value.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period that contains the accounting entry.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the accounting entry application.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal will be stored.
